summary: rrweb-snapshot may execute scripts when rebuilding untrusted snapshots
details:
`rrweb-snapshot` versions from 1.0.0 before 2.0.0 may execute attacker-controlled JavaScript when `rebuild()` reconstructs a crafted snapshot into an unprotected browser document. This can affect applications that replay untrusted or attacker-controlled rrweb data.

Version 2.0.0 contains the fix from rrweb-io/rrweb#1834. Browser rebuilds now require a sandboxed iframe document created by `rebuildIntoSandboxedIframe()` or `createSandboxedIframe()` by default. Applications can explicitly opt out with `UNSAFE_allowUnprotectedRebuild: true` only when they accept the script-execution risk.
